title: Chapter 521
text:
The Andrea Mainland was once an area controlled by the Germinal Organization. It was suffering from the aftereffects of the Old Era's war. The Six Nations' expedition a few years ago had caused the environment of this land to deteriorate again. The nuclear radiation level was much higher than the warning line, and the land was scorched black. The wanderer tribes that used to live on this land had been moved to the other three mainlands by the Six Nations. Andrea was now deserted, and only mutated beasts were left.

The ruins of the Germinal Organization were located on this land. The once majestic base had turned into a black scorched ruin. The central base had disappeared, and only a black circle was left. The underground base had also been destroyed. The edge of the circle was a black line that radiated outward, extending for hundreds of miles.

Due to the high concentration of nuclear radiation, after the nuclear explosion, the Six Nations only sent out a few drones to explore the ruins. Nothing of value was left behind, and there were no signs of life. Everyone had died in the frenzy of the serial nuclear attacks.

Therefore, the Six Nations did not waste their energy cleaning up this mess. After a few years, the ruins of the Germinal Organization were covered in a thick layer of dust. Some of the metal fragments that were thrown into the ground by the explosion had already shown signs of erosion. The air was filled with death and decay.

However, in this area where even mutated beasts could not survive, a human figure stood in the center of the ruins of the Germinal Organization base. Although it was called a human figure, it was actually a scorched skeleton. The steel-like flesh had been burned away in the explosion a few years ago, but the charred skeleton had remained and did not turn into dust. After a few years, it still had not decomposed into dust. Only the body of a Super had far more tenacity than that of a normal person.

However, it was obvious that the signs of life of this body had long disappeared. The gray dust in the air danced in and out of the empty eye sockets.

However, such a corpse was moving slowly at this moment. Step by step, its footsteps were unsteady. A pool of black mucus was attached to its neck, extending out thread-like roots that wrapped around the bones of its limbs. It was like a puppeteer, and this skeleton was like a marionette.

This puddle of black liquid was the Mutation Source. After going through the 'Infant Stage' where it could only passively absorb free energy, it could actively search for energy and constantly change its target. After trekking through mountains and rivers, it finally crossed the ocean and arrived at the Andrea Continent. It shared the senses of countless lifeforms, and not only was the energy there massive, it was also the easiest type of energy for it to absorb. It was rich in nutrients.

The Germinal Organization ruins were a forbidden zone for life. The beast that the Mutation Source possessed had died in the forbidden zone, and it could only move its main body to the center of the ruins. At this moment, the skeleton that it was controlling was the only corpse in the center of the Germinal Organization ruins. It was the corpse of the Germinal Organization leader. At the time of the explosion, the leader was located in the underground base. With layers of barriers and a strong body, he was able to preserve his body. However, the others had long been reduced to ashes.

On an unseen level, the nuclear radiation in the center of the Germinal Organization ruins was being continuously absorbed by the Mutation Source. On a microscopic level, the rate at which the Mutation Source was reproducing had increased by a hundred times. The reproducing material was also continuously evaporating, turning into energy that the Mutation Source could control.

In the storyline of his previous life, Tyne had discovered the Mutation Source after being released from prison and became the host of the Mutation Source. However, Tyne had now been captured by Han Xiao for labor reform. Without this powerful 'carrier', the Mutation Source had wasted a lot of time on the road.

However, in the storyline of his previous life, it was not as good a 'cradle' as the Germinal Organization ruins.

The skeleton moved slowly, and the Mutation Source absorbed the energy as though it was thirsting for it. The concentration of nuclear radiation decreased at a speed that was hard to discern with the naked eye.

…

Nakapu's fleet was floating behind a desolate planet. From there, they only needed a short jump to reach Blue Star. The distance was already extremely close, and this was the last area where the stealth mode was effective. If they got any closer, the stealth device would no longer be able to fool Godora's military radar, and the gravitational pull of the fleet would expose their location.

This was like being in the deep sea. Their vision was pitch black, and they could only use the water flow to determine if there was an enemy approaching. The closer they were, the more obvious the water flow would be. Gravity was like water flow, and the stealth mode would lose its effectiveness if they were too close. The exact distance depended on the radar.

Both sides had been enemies for many years, and Dark-star was extremely clear about the capabilities of Godora's military equipment. At the same time, they were also constantly improving their stealth technology.

The interior of the command ship was extremely busy, and they were making the final preparations before the attack. Nakapu confirmed all sorts of information with the scouts.

"How many defenses does Blue Star have?"

"There are 120 Godora frigates outside the atmosphere. This is a medium-sized fleet and should be a force sent out from the Nadban military base."

"Does the stealth team have any information?"

"Yes. They said that other than the frigates, there are also more than ten spaceships from Godora's disaster relief team. The one leading them is a high-ranking official from the War Bureau, Nagojin. He's a Pugilist and has the strength of a Calamity Grade."

Nakapu was expressionless. "A Calamity Grade Expert? This is a little troublesome. We don't have any high-level combatants on our side, so we can eliminate the option of boarding. Luckily, it's just a Pugilist. Is there any other information?"

"Other than Godora, there's another organization on Blue Star, Floating Dragon Island's Field Team Black Star Mercenary. They also have more than ten spaceships."

Nakapu's eyes did not waver. "Black Star … is the mercenary who killed Anur in Noriose a year ago. They're also a group of troublesome fellows. It seems like Blue Star is a little special. Their defense is stronger than the previous two planets, so it will be a little troublesome. Then, we'll proceed with Plan 4."

Nakapu was not too surprised to know that Black Star was on Blue Star. To him, it was just one more enemy to deal with, and there was no need to make a fuss.

It was not that Nakapu was underestimating the enemy. After quickly estimating the strength of the enemy, he had decided to continue with the mission.

In other words, the addition of the Black Star Mercenary only increased the difficulty of the mission by a little.

…

"Dark-star might appear at any time. I want all of you to react immediately. Open your eyes wide and stay alert!"

In the atmosphere of Blue Star, the commander of Godora's guard fleet, Barette, spoke loudly in the communication channel. He was a short Godora with a fiery temper, and his voice was like thunder.

"Commander Barette, the radar has found the target. A fleet is rapidly approaching … They stopped! Their position is in the direction of 02-07! "

Barette immediately looked at the radar screen. More than a hundred light spots were displayed on the screen. This was Dark-star's fleet. He looked out the porthole, but he did not see any Dark-star's fleet in that direction. The distance between the two sides was beyond visual range, and both sides were at their maximum firing range.

Buzz buzz buzz

At this time, the alarm in the command room suddenly sounded, and a red light flashed.

"Warning! Detected a high-index energy reaction approaching! A collision is about to occur! "

Outside the porthole, thousands of green light spots suddenly lit up in the dark universe, and a dense cluster of ion cannons shot over.

Nakapu's fleet had used an over-visual range attack!
